Code discovered in the latest WhatsApp TestFlight beta suggests Meta is developing an alternative to iCloud backups for iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp is developing its own backup service

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users as an alternative to iCloud.

This feature is not yet available to WhatsApp TestFlight users, but WABetaInfo has managed to enable an interface that lets users choose between iCloud and WhatsApp's own cloud service for backup storage. The interface shows it will offer 2GB of free storage, with paid plans reportedly going up to 1TB.

The report also notes that users can choose whether WhatsApp backups on iCloud use end-to-end encryption, but WhatsApp's own backup system will have end-to-end encryption enabled by default.

WABetaInfo's content reads:

Although there is no official timeline for this feature, the report says WhatsApp is also working on an alternative to Google Drive backups for Android users. Given that work is underway on both platforms, the feature could be officially announced in the near future.
